raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Enable breakable CUDA graphs for native SANA-Video 2.0, following #35729.

## Modifications

- Connect the custom samplers to the shared BCG runner. Capture T2V and TI2V during warmup; replay matching requests and run unseen shapes eagerly.
- Keep the transformer resident and cache RoPE frequencies on device.
- Add a serving example and focused regression coverage.

## Accuracy Tests

On A800, T2V/TI2V videos matched eager exactly, including decoded frames. Changed prompts/seeds, restored inputs, and an uncaptured frame count also matched; those lifecycle probes used four steps. Focused tests and pre-commit passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

A800, 832×480, 81 frames, 50 steps, guidance 8, seed 42, all components resident, torch.compile disabled. Means of three requests after warmup; e2e includes video saving.

| Task | Path | Logged denoise (ms/step) | Logged decode (s) | Saved-request e2e (s) |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| T2V | eager | 692.8 | 0.12 | 35.96 |
| T2V | BCG | 576.1 | 3.71 | 35.74 |
| TI2V | eager | 694.2 | 0.12 | 36.06 |
| TI2V | BCG | 552.3 | 4.75 | 35.91 |

Logged denoise falls by 16.9% / 20.4%, while e2e improves by 0.6% / 0.4%. Stage timing is unsynchronized: queued GPU work can be charged to decode or later synchronization, so the denoise figures are not isolated GPU speedups.

Peak reserved memory increases from 20.65 to 21.32 GiB. Startup including warmup increases from 23.8 to 62.7 seconds.

## Generated videos

T2V:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3b11c3e5-9c15-4f11-9869-f3b01399e836

TI2V:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/49f7879f-7c19-45c0-870c-e587e05bed26

 counts align to `8n+1`; width and height must be divisible by 32. The 4-step
 preview is a different checkpoint and is not supported by this pipeline.
 
+For repeated requests at a fixed shape on an NVIDIA CUDA GPU with enough memory
+to keep all components resident, capture breakable CUDA graphs at startup:
+
+```bash Command
+sglang serve \
+  --model-path Efficient-Large-Model/SANA-Video_2.0_5B_720p \
+  --performance-mode manual --component-residency=all=resident \
+  --enable-breakable-cuda-graph --enable-torch-compile false \
+  --warmup-resolutions 832x480 --warmup-num-frames 81 \
+  --port 30010
+```
+
+This captures text-to-video and first-frame image-conditioned timestep shapes
+for 832×480, 81-frame requests. Other resolutions or frame counts run eagerly.
+The default prompt length is fixed at 300 tokens, so no text bucket flag is
+needed for this command.

 `/path/to/SANA-Video_2.0_5B_720p`, and pass it as `--model-path`. That directory

@@ -121,6 +138,118 @@ def test_denoising_stage_role():
     assert stage.role_affinity is RoleType.DENOISER
 
 
+def _denoising_stage(transformer):
+    stage = object.__new__(sana_video2.SanaVideo2DenoisingStage)
+    stage.transformer = transformer
+    stage._bcg_runner = None
+    stage.begin_declared_component_use = lambda **_: None
+    stage.progress_bar = lambda **_: nullcontext(SimpleNamespace(update=lambda: None))
+    return stage
+
+
+def _denoising_batch(*, condition_image=None, is_warmup=False, cfg=True):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        condition_image=condition_image,
+        do_classifier_free_guidance=cfg,
+        prompt_embeds=[torch.ones(1, 300, 4)],
+        prompt_attention_mask=[torch.ones(1, 300, dtype=torch.long)],
+        negative_prompt_embeds=[torch.zeros(1, 300, 4)],
+        negative_attention_mask=[torch.ones(1, 300, dtype=torch.long)],
+        latents=torch.ones(1, 2, 3, 1, 1),
+        guidance_scale=8.0,
+        num_inference_steps=2,
+        is_warmup=is_warmup,
+        flow_shift=None,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("conditioned", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cfg", [False, True])
+def test_denoising_bcg_captures_t2v_and_ti2v_at_warmup_only(
+    monkeypatch, conditioned, cfg
+):
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.breakable_cuda_graph import runner as bcg_module
+
+    instances = []
+
+    class Transformer(torch.nn.Module):
+        def forward(self, **kwargs):
+            return torch.zeros_like(kwargs["hidden_states"])
+
+    class Runner:
+        def __init__(self, transformer, device):
+            self.transformer = transformer
+            self.captures = []
+            self.calls = []
+            instances.append(self)
+
+        def capture(self, **kwargs):
+            self.captures.append(kwargs)
+            return True
+
+        def __call__(self, **kwargs):
+            self.calls.append(kwargs)
+            return self.transformer(**kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(bcg_module, "DiffusionBreakableCudaGraphRunner", Runner)
+    stage = _denoising_stage(Transformer())
+    args = SimpleNamespace(
+        enable_breakable_cuda_graph=True,
+        pipeline_config=SimpleNamespace(flow_shift=12.0),
+    )
+
+    stage.forward(
+        _denoising_batch(
+            is_warmup=True, condition_image=object() if conditioned else None, cfg=cfg
+        ),
+        args,
+    )
+    assert len(instances) == 1
+    runner = instances[0]
+    batch_size = 2 if cfg else 1
+    assert len(runner.captures) == 2
+    assert {tuple(call["timestep"].shape) for call in runner.captures} == {
+        (batch_size,),
+        (batch_size, 1, 3, 1, 1),
+    }
+    assert all(
+        call["encoder_hidden_states"].shape == (batch_size, 300, 4)
+        for call in runner.captures
+    )
+    assert all(call["timestep"].dtype == torch.float32 for call in runner.captures)
+    framewise = next(
+        call["timestep"] for call in runner.captures if call["timestep"].ndim == 5
+    )
+    assert torch.count_nonzero(framewise[:, :, 0]) == 0
+    assert torch.all(framewise[:, :, 1:] > 0)
+    captures = len(runner.captures)
+    stage.forward(_denoising_batch(condition_image=object(), cfg=cfg), args)
+    assert len(instances) == 1
+    assert len(runner.captures) == captures
+    assert runner.calls[-1]["timestep"].shape == (batch_size, 1, 3, 1, 1)
+
+
+def test_denoising_without_bcg_calls_transformer_directly():
+    class Transformer(torch.nn.Module):
+        def __init__(self):
+            super().__init__()
+            self.calls = 0
+
+        def forward(self, **kwargs):
+            self.calls += 1
+            return torch.zeros_like(kwargs["hidden_states"])
+
+    stage = _denoising_stage(Transformer())
+    stage.forward(
+        _denoising_batch(cfg=False),
+        SimpleNamespace(
+            enable_breakable_cuda_graph=False,
+            pipeline_config=SimpleNamespace(flow_shift=12.0),
+        ),
+    )
+    assert stage.transformer.calls == 2
+
+
